questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "At our neighbourhood meeting, several people speak about the empty square. They want a place where children and older neighbours can spend time together. The organiser provides us with large sheets of paper for drawing ideas. One group draws benches, and another suggests small tables for board games. We compare the drawings and notice that both leave space for wheelchairs. A volunteer combines the strongest parts into one plan for the next meeting. Everyone leaves with a copy so they can think about it at home." This supports the answer: "Neighbours share and combine ideas for a common space".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：社区会议上，几个人谈到那块空地。 他们想要一个让孩子和年长邻居共处的地方。 组织者给我们提供大张纸，供我们画想法。 一组画长椅，另一组建议放玩棋盘游戏的小桌。 我们比较图画，发现两种方案都留出了轮椅通行空间。 一位志愿者把最好的部分合成一个方案，留待下次会议。 每个人离开时都拿了一份，便于回家继续想。 因此正确选项为“Neighbours share and combine ideas for a common space”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Our geography teacher asks us to plan an imaginary island visit. The class is divided into three groups, each with a different job. My group chooses places where visitors could learn about the island. Another group works out how the visitors would travel between them. We hope to take a trip there one day, but today our journey is on paper. When we bring our ideas together, we find that one boat ride takes too long. We change the route and present a plan with enough time for every stop." This supports the answer: "Planning an Island Journey Together".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：地理老师让我们规划一次想象中的小岛之旅。 全班被分成三组，每组负责不同的工作。 我这组选择游客可以了解小岛的地点。 另一组研究游客如何在这些地点之间往返。 我们希望将来去那里旅行，但今天的旅程只在纸上。 合并想法时，我们发现有一段船程太长。 我们更改路线，展示一个每站都有充足时间的方案。 因此正确选项为“Planning an Island Journey Together”。
